en.short_summary: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview is Google’s frontier reasoning model, significantly improving software engineering performance, agent reliability, and token efficiency in complex workflows. Built on the multimodal foundation of the Gemini 3 family, it provides high-precision reasoning over text, images, video, audio, and code, with a 1 million-token context window. It is designed for advanced development and agentic systems, improving long-term stability, tool orchestration, and token efficiency. It introduces a new intermediate thinking mode to better balance cost, speed, and performance. The model performs well in agentic coding, structured planning, multimodal analysis, and workflow automation, making it well suited for autonomous agents, financial modeling, spreadsheet automation, and high-context enterprise tasks.
en.description_long: Wide ecosystem compatibility; weaker than 4o line but cheap and stable.

zh.short_summary: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview 是 Google 的前沿推理模型，可显著提升软件工程性能、增强代理可靠性，并在复杂的工作流程中实现更高效的令牌使用。它基于 Gemini 3 系列的多模态基础，结合了对文本、图像、视频、音频和代码的高精度推理，并拥有 100 万个令牌的上下文窗口。Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview 专为高级开发和智能体系统而设计，在提升令牌效率的同时，增强了长期稳定性、工具编排能力。它引入了一种新的中间思维模式，以更好地平衡成本、速度和性能。该模型在智能体编码、结构化规划、多模态分析和工作流自动化方面表现出色，因此非常适合自主智能体、金融建模、电子表格自动化和高上下文企业任务。
zh.description_long: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview 是 Google 的前沿推理模型，可显著提升软件工程性能、增强代理可靠性，并在复杂的工作流程中实现更高效的令牌使用。它基于 Gemini 3 系列的多模态基础，结合了对文本、图像、视频、音频和代码的高精度推理，并拥有 100 万个令牌的上下文窗口。Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview 专为高级开发和智能体系统而设计，在提升令牌效率的同时，增强了长期稳定性、工具编排能力。它引入了一种新的中间思维模式，以更好地平衡成本、速度和性能。该模型在智能体编码、结构化规划、多模态分析和工作流自动化方面表现出色，因此非常适合自主智能体、金融建模、电子表格自动化和高上下文企业任务。 由Google研发，适合对话与 Agent等场景；请结合业务需求评估延迟、成本与内容安全策略。

en.description_long: Zhipu AI GLM-5.3 is the latest flagship text model. Built on the same base as GLM-5.2, it raises capability via large-scale long-horizon training environments and extended post-training. Coding feel improves ~50% vs prior gen; strong on Terminal-Bench 3.0, DeepSWE, and Agents' Last Exam among open models. Suited for deep reasoning, complex engineering, agent orchestration, and long-running tasks. Supports mandatory deep thinking, reasoning_effort (max/high/low), tool calling, streaming, structured output, implicit context cache, and MCP. Text-only input; 1M context and up to 128K output.

It sets a new bar across coding, knowledge work, cybersecurity, and science while delivering stronger performance per dollar with fewer tokens. It supports max reasoning effort and multi-agent parallelism (ultra / multi-agent), plus programmatic tool calling, explicit prompt caching, persisted reasoning, and stronger frontend design judgment—ideal for demanding software engineering, long-horizon agents, professional artifacts, and complex tool-heavy workflows. Developed by OpenAI; evaluate latency, cost, and safety policies for your use case.
